en.name: Pork roll
en.summary: Pork roll — Taylor ham to half of New Jersey — is a cured, smoked, ground pork product sold in a cloth-wrapped log or in slices, and fried before eating. Unopened, there is no fixed number: keep it refrigerated and go by the use-by date on the package. Once opened it keeps 7 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: Pork roll is a refrigerated product and does not belong in a cupboard, whatever the cured, smoky look of it suggests. It is ground meat that has been cured and cooked, then packed moist — the cure slows spoilage but does not make it shelf-stable. Outside the fridge it is bound by the two-hour rule, or one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F), and a fried slice left on a plate counts the same as a raw one.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. For an unopened pack the honest answer is a rule rather than a number: there is no published shelf life, so the use-by date printed on the package is what you follow, and this page will not invent a figure to sit alongside it. Once you open it — cut the cloth off a log, or break the seal on a pack of slices — you have 7 days. Re-wrap the cut face tightly or move slices to a sealed box, keep it on a shelf rather than the door, and fry it through before eating.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for pork roll here, so none is offered. It can be frozen and will be safe indefinitely at −18 °C (0 °F), but it is a fine-ground, moist cured product, and freezing tends to make it crumbly and to dull the smoke. If you have a whole log you cannot finish, slicing and cooking it, then eating the cooked slices within a couple of days, is a better plan than freezing it raw.
en.thawing: If it has been frozen, thaw it in the fridge, still wrapped, and fry it straight afterwards. Never thaw on the counter.
spoilage: Slime or a tacky film on the surface of the log or the slices.
A sour or yeasty smell instead of a smoky, faintly sweet one.
Grey-green patches or any mould on a cut face.
A pack that is puffy or leaking before you open it.
tips: Write the opening date on the wrapper; the unopened date on the pack is not the same clock.
Buy a smaller log if a week is more than you will get through.
Score the edges of thick slices before frying so they stay flat.
Keep it on a fridge shelf, not in the door, where temperatures swing.

faq.q: How long does pork roll keep after opening?
faq.a: 7 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, tightly re-wrapped.

faq.q: How long does an unopened pork roll keep?
faq.a: There is no published figure. Keep it refrigerated and follow the use-by date printed on the package.
No timeline is given for it. It would be safe at −18 °C, but the texture goes crumbly and the smoke flavour fades.

zh.name: 美式豬肉捲腸
zh.summary: Pork roll（在紐澤西有一半的人叫它 Taylor ham）是醃漬煙燻的豬絞肉製品，以布捲包成一條或切片販售，吃之前要煎過。未開封沒有固定天數：請冷藏並以包裝上的有效日期為準。開封後在 4 °C 以下可放 7 天。
zh.pantry: 不管它看起來多像可以常溫放的醃燻品，pork roll 就是冷藏品，不該進櫥櫃。它是醃過又煮過的絞肉，包裝時仍然帶著水分——醃漬只是延緩腐敗，並沒有讓它常溫穩定。離開冰箱後受 2 小時原則規範，廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時；煎好放在盤子上的那片，算法跟生的一樣。
zh.fridge: 請放 4 °C 以下。未開封的誠實答案是一條規則而不是一個數字：它沒有公開的保存期限，所以請以包裝上印的有效日期為準，本頁也不會另外湊一個數字給你。一旦開封——把整條的布拆掉，或把切片包的封口撕開——就是 7 天。切面重新包緊，或把切片移到密封盒，放層架而不是冰箱門，吃之前要煎透。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給 pork roll 的冷凍期限，所以本頁也不給。它當然可以冷凍，在 −18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，但它是細絞、含水的醃製品，冷凍後容易變得鬆散粉粉的，煙燻香也會變淡。整條吃不完的話，比起生凍，更好的做法是切片煎熟，再在兩三天內把熟的吃完。
zh.thawing: 如果已經冷凍，請維持包裝放冷藏解凍，解凍後立刻下鍋煎。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 整條或切片表面發黏、有一層黏膜。
聞起來發酸或有酵母味，而不是帶點甜的煙燻香。
切面出現灰綠色斑塊或任何霉點。
還沒開封就已經脹袋或滲液。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日；未開封的有效日期是另一套時鐘。
如果一週吃不完，下次買短一點的。
厚片下鍋前在邊緣劃幾刀，煎起來才不會捲。
放冰箱層架而不是門邊，那裡溫度比較穩。

faq.q: pork roll 開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 重新包緊，放 4 °C 以下 7 天。

faq.q: 未開封的 pork roll 可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有公開數字。請冷藏保存，並以包裝上印的有效日期為準。
沒有給對應期限。−18 °C 下安全沒問題，但口感會變鬆散，煙燻香也會變淡。
